title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Dynamic language model representations for multi-objective reaction optimisation
items.abstract_or_text: Optimising chemical reactions across multiple objectives, such as yield, selectivity, and safety, is central to chemical synthesis, and model-driven approaches depend critically on how reaction components are represented. Established featurisations are either chemically uninformative, as with one-hot encodings, or, as with molecular descriptors, do not readily extend across chemically distinct components. For structurally and functionally diverse components, it is therefore unclear what a shared representation should contain. Constructing such a representation is itself a challenging research undertaking that must be revisited for each new reaction system. Here we bypass this step by learning the reaction representation dynamically from text. Textual descriptions of reaction conditions are encoded by a fine-tuned language model trained jointly with Gaussian process surrogates, yielding task-adaptive representations within a multi-objective Bayesian optimisation loop. Across nickel- and palladium-catalysed cross-couplings in both sequential and parallel experimentation regimes, this approach reaches optimisation convergence in fewer experiments than descriptor libraries or one-hot encoding. Applied prospectively to a palladium-catalysed cyanation spanning mixed ligand denticity and heterogeneous additives, and to a three-objective asymmetric hydrogenation across chiral iridium and ruthenium catalyst families, two rounds of high-throughput experimentation (192 reactions, under 3% of each design space) delivered conditions translating directly to gram scale in 94% and 84% isolated yield, the latter at 99.6% enantiomeric excess.
items.summary_zh: 该研究将反应条件的文本描述经微调语言模型编码，并与高斯过程代理模型联合训练，用于多目标贝叶斯反应优化。在镍、钯交叉偶联及前瞻性钯催化氰化和不对称氢化中，模型以更少实验收敛；两轮高通量实验后，条件可直接放大至克级，并分别得到 94% 和 84% 收率，后者 ee 为 99.6%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把可随任务调整的语言表征直接接入实验闭环，并给出前瞻性高通量实验和克级验证，是反应优化中较强的实证证据。其跨反应类别、跨实验室以及面对不完整或歧义条件文本时的稳健性仍需进一步检验。
items.abstract_zh: 在产率、选择性和安全性等多个目标之间优化化学反应是化学合成的核心问题，而模型驱动方法关键取决于如何表征反应组分。既有特征化方法要么像 one-hot 编码一样缺乏化学信息，要么像分子描述符一样难以在化学上不同的组分之间直接推广。因此，对于结构和功能多样的组分，共享表征应包含什么尚不清楚。构建这种表征本身就是一项具有挑战性的研究工作，并且必须针对每个新的反应体系重新开展。这里，我们通过从文本中动态学习反应表征而绕过这一步骤。反应条件的文本描述由一个与高斯过程代理模型联合训练的微调语言模型编码，从而在多目标贝叶斯优化循环内得到任务自适应表征。在串行和并行实验条件下，针对镍催化和钯催化交叉偶联，该方法比描述符库或 one-hot 编码以更少的实验达到优化收敛。将其前瞻性应用于跨越混合配位齿数配体和非均相添加剂的钯催化氰化，以及跨越手性铱和钌催化剂家族的三目标不对称氢化时，两轮高通量实验（192 个反应，占各自设计空间不足 3%）给出的条件可直接放大至克级，分离收率分别为 94% 和 84%，后者具有 99.6% 的对映体过量。
items.author_line: Joshua W. Sin, David Ming Segura, Bojana Ranković, Siu Lun Chau, Marius D. R. Lutz, Andrea Anelli, Ryan P. Burwood, Kurt Püntener, Maximilian J. Notheis, Raphael Bigler, Philippe Schwaller

items.title: Reframing enzyme function prediction as conditional generation
items.abstract_or_text: Enzymes frequently exhibit promiscuous activity beyond their native roles, providing starting-points for new functions. Finding these promiscuous enzymes, especially for non-native chemical transformations, is challenging but highly valuable, as they promise novel, sustainable solutions for chemistry and biotechnology. However, current machine learning methods are poorly suited to discovering unseen chemistry as they often frame function prediction as closed set classification or a retrieval task. Here, we present Fluxion, a generative deep learning framework that learns enzymatic catalysis by modeling dynamic electron flow trajectories across the enzyme's catalytic residues. By combining both synthetic chemistry and biochemical datasets with protein language model representations, Fluxion generates multi-step electron-flow trajectories analogous to the arrow-pushing representations used to describe enzyme reaction mechanisms. Generation is conditioned on enzyme context, including the enzyme sequence, catalytic residues, substrates, and cofactors. We show that this conditioning allows Fluxion to learn enzyme-dependent regioselectivity across cytochrome P450 enzymes with different sequences shifting the predicted reaction sites for the same substrate. We then demonstrate that Fluxion's embeddings are useful for downstream tasks, such as specificity prediction on two experimental datasets, with and without finetuning. Finally, we show that Fluxion has the potential to transfer synthetic chemical logic to biology; it can generate the observed non-native product from real-world non-native directed evolution screens. Our results establish a proof of concept that generative modeling through mechanistic representations of enzymes can shift enzyme function prediction beyond static database retrieval and closed set classification to function generation. This conceptual framework provides a stepping stone towards an in silico generative method to discover non-native biocatalysts.
items.summary_zh: Fluxion 将酶功能预测重构为条件生成任务：结合蛋白语言模型表征、合成化学和生化数据，生成催化残基间的多步电子流轨迹。模型在 P450 区域选择性、两个实验特异性数据集及非天然定向进化筛选产物上进行了评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 以机理式电子流作为生成对象，有望突破封闭类别分类和数据库检索对未知酶化学的限制。现有结果仍是概念验证；非天然生物催化剂的真实前瞻性发现及湿实验验证尚待展示。
items.abstract_zh: 酶常常在其天然功能之外表现出兼容性活性，为新功能提供起点。寻找这些兼容性酶，尤其是用于非天然化学转化的酶，具有挑战性但价值很高，因为它们有望为化学和生物技术提供新颖、可持续的解决方案。然而，当前机器学习方法不适于发现未知化学，因为它们通常将功能预测构建为封闭集合分类或检索任务。这里，我们提出 Fluxion，这是一个生成式深度学习框架，通过模拟酶催化残基之间的动态电子流轨迹来学习酶催化。通过结合合成化学和生化数据集与蛋白语言模型表征，Fluxion 生成多步电子流轨迹，类似于用于描述酶反应机制的推箭表示。生成以酶上下文为条件，包括酶序列、催化残基、底物和辅因子。我们表明，这种条件化使 Fluxion 能够学习细胞色素 P450 酶之间依赖于酶的区域选择性：不同序列会使同一底物的预测反应位点发生变化。随后，我们证明 Fluxion 的嵌入可用于下游任务，例如在两个实验数据集上进行特异性预测，且可在有或无微调时使用。最后，我们表明 Fluxion 有可能将合成化学逻辑迁移至生物学；它能够生成真实世界非天然定向进化筛选中观察到的非天然产物。我们的结果确立了一个概念验证：通过酶的机理表征进行生成建模，可将酶功能预测从静态数据库检索和封闭集合分类转向功能生成。该概念框架为建立发现非天然生物催化剂的 in silico 生成方法提供了垫脚石。
items.author_line: Rieger, W. J., Haeussermann, S., Herrmann, L., Li, Z., Frohn, B. P., Maluenda, M., Lobinska, G., Loomba, S., Reisenbauer, J. C., Boden, M., Tong, A., Mora, A.

items.title: IntelliPore: A Foundation Model for Gas Adsorption in Porous Materials
items.abstract_or_text: Porous materials, such as metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), covalent organic frameworks (COFs), and zeolites, hold great promise for energy and environmental applications, particularly in gas storage and separation technologies. However, their rapidly expanding design space, driven by experimental synthesis and computational modeling, challenges traditional exploration methods. Machine learning has emerged as a promising alternative, yet current approaches are typically developed for specific adsorption properties or material families. Consequently, each new property or material class requires training a new model from scratch using large amounts of labeled data, which are often not available. Inspired by the emerging foundation-model paradigm that has transformed computer vision and natural language processing, we introduce IntelliPore, a foundation model tailored for gas adsorption in porous materials. By pretraining on 12.5 million publicly available adsorption data from MOFs and COFs, IntelliPore learns transferable knowledge across adsorption tasks and material classes, enabling generalization to previously unseen materials such as zeolites and porous polymer networks. It demonstrates strong few-shot learning capabilities, substantially improving sample efficiency compared with the traditional approach of training from scratch. Furthermore, it achieves state-of-the-art performance in adsorption property prediction with exceptional parameter efficiency, requiring only 0.86 million parameters—two orders of magnitude fewer than existing leading models. To facilitate broader adoption, IntelliPore is made publicly available to the research community and accessible through a web application. Collectively, these advances establish IntelliPore as a practical foundation for data-driven adsorption modeling in porous materials and represent a step toward the emerging paradigm of foundation-style models in materials science.
items.summary_zh: IntelliPore 是面向多孔材料气体吸附的基础模型，在 1,250 万条公开 MOF 和 COF 吸附数据上预训练，并报告可迁移到沸石和多孔聚合物网络等未见材料类别。作者称其以 0.86 million 参数实现较强的小样本性能和吸附性质预测表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作尝试将大规模预训练从单一材料族或性质推广至多孔材料吸附任务，并提供公开模型和网页入口。性能结论主要依赖公开数据与预测基准；不同材料的标签质量、分布偏移和实验可合成性仍是实际筛选中的关键限制。
items.abstract_zh: 金属有机框架（MOFs）、共价有机框架（COFs）和沸石等多孔材料在能源和环境应用中具有很大前景，尤其是在气体储存和分离技术方面。然而，由实验合成和计算建模推动的快速扩张设计空间，对传统探索方法提出了挑战。机器学习已成为一种有前景的替代方案，但当前方法通常是为特定吸附性质或材料家族开发的。因此，每一种新性质或材料类别都需要使用大量通常不可获得的带标签数据从头训练新模型。受已改变计算机视觉和自然语言处理的基础模型范式启发，我们引入 IntelliPore，这是一种专为多孔材料气体吸附定制的基础模型。通过在来自 MOFs 和 COFs 的 1,250 万条公开吸附数据上进行预训练，IntelliPore 学习了可在吸附任务和材料类别之间迁移的知识，从而能够泛化到此前未见的材料，如沸石和多孔聚合物网络。与从头训练的传统方法相比，它表现出强大的小样本学习能力，并显著提高了样本效率。此外，它以出色的参数效率在吸附性质预测中达到 state-of-the-art 性能，仅需 0.86 million 个参数，比现有领先模型少两个数量级。为促进更广泛采用，IntelliPore 已向研究社区公开，并可通过网页应用访问。总体而言，这些进展使 IntelliPore 成为数据驱动多孔材料吸附建模的实用基础，并代表了材料科学中基础模型风格范式的一个步骤。
items.author_line: Antonios P. Sarikas, George E. Froudakis

items.title: Descriptor-Based Pre-Training Improves Reaction Property Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Pre-training graph neural networks on large unlabeled datasets has substantially improved molecular property prediction, yet pre-training approaches for reaction property prediction remain underexplored. We introduce CheMeleon-Rxn, a pre-trained reaction graph neural network that adapts the CheMeleon framework to condensed graphs of reaction (CGR) and demonstrates that descriptor-regression is an effective pre-training strategy for low-data reaction property prediction. An O(10M)-parameter D-MPNN encoder was pre-trained on ∼2 million reactions by regressing onto dense reaction descriptors pooled from classical molecular descriptors, then fine-tuned on small reaction property prediction datasets. Across regression tasks spanning gasphase activation energies, reaction enthalpies, experimental yields, and rate coefficients, CheMeleon-Rxn is best or statistically tied-for-best on seven of eight tasks. It outperforms the same encoder trained from scratch, as well as classical-descriptor, fingerprint, and pre-trained-fingerprint baselines. We further tested the pre-training strategy across various graph neural network architectures and found that its benefit holds for other edge-aware backbones such as GINE, and that it is robust to the choice of descriptor set, pooling operation, and other pre-training hyperparameters. We visualized and analyzed the CheMeleon-Rxn embeddings, which reveal chemically coherent structure in the learned reaction representation space. The CheMeleon-Rxn code has been released publicly (https://github.com/MSDLLCpapers/chemeleon-rxn) to encourage adoption and extension by the community. The model weights will be released upon publication.
items.summary_zh: CheMeleon-Rxn 在约 200 万个反应上以稠合反应图（CGR）和描述符回归预训练 D-MPNN，随后微调低数据量反应性质任务。在活化能、反应焓、实验收率和速率系数等八项回归任务中，模型在七项上最佳或与最佳无统计学差异。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究为反应图网络预训练提供了可复现、可跨骨干网络检验的方案，并覆盖热力学、动力学和产率任务。模型权重仍待论文发表后发布，且其在真正新颖反应空间中的外推能力不能仅由现有基准确定。
items.abstract_zh: 在大型无标签数据集上预训练图神经网络已显著改善分子性质预测，但面向反应性质预测的预训练方法仍研究不足。我们引入 CheMeleon-Rxn，这是一种预训练反应图神经网络，将 CheMeleon 框架适配至稠合反应图（CGR），并证明描述符回归是低数据量反应性质预测的有效预训练策略。一个具有 O(10M) 参数的 D-MPNN 编码器在约 200 万个反应上预训练，方法是回归由经典分子描述符汇聚得到的稠密反应描述符，随后在小型反应性质预测数据集上微调。在涵盖气相活化能、反应焓、实验收率和速率系数的回归任务中，CheMeleon-Rxn 在八项任务中的七项上最佳或在统计学上与最佳并列。它优于从头训练的同一编码器，以及经典描述符、指纹和预训练指纹基线。我们还在多种图神经网络架构上测试了该预训练策略，发现其益处同样适用于 GINE 等其他边感知骨干网络，并且对描述符集合、汇聚操作和其他预训练超参数的选择具有稳健性。我们对 CheMeleon-Rxn 嵌入进行了可视化和分析，显示学习到的反应表征空间具有化学上一致的结构。CheMeleon-Rxn 代码已公开发布（https://github.com/MSDLLCpapers/chemeleon-rxn），以鼓励社区采用和扩展。模型权重将在发表时发布。
items.author_line: Akshat Shirish Zalte, Cheng Fang, Yiting Zheng, Essam Metwally, Alan Cheng, Alec Glisman, Hao-Wei Pang

items.title: Autonomous Chemical Mechanistic Discovery through Agentic Reasoning and Validation
items.abstract_or_text: Unraveling reaction mechanisms is central to modern chemistry, yet automating these investigations remains challenging because computational workflows still rely heavily on expert intervention. Here we introduce ARCHE, an autonomous agentic system that integrates a general-purpose reasoning model, a domain-specialized computational chemistry model, and a structured tool registry to transform mechanistic inquiry into a scalable, self-validating process. ARCHE interprets scientific questions, generates and prioritizes mechanistic hypotheses, orchestrates computational workflows, and iteratively refines conclusions based on computed evidence within a closed loop. We validate its capabilities across three increasingly demanding scenarios: reconstructing stereocontrolling transition states and validating the corresponding reaction mechanism in a previously reported asymmetric catalytic reaction; proposing and validating a plausible radical pathway through iterative hypothesis refinement for a recently discovered but unpublished α-iodoboronate C-I cleavage reaction; and identifying a chemically interpretable descriptor that governs selectivity in nickel-catalysed migratory cross-coupling reactions. By coupling agentic reasoning with rigorous computational validation, ARCHE advances autonomous mechanistic discovery and establishes a foundation for broader machine-assisted chemical research. The code for ARCHE is publicly available at https://github.com/JetAstra/Arche-Harness.
items.summary_zh: ARCHE 将通用推理模型、领域计算化学模型和工具注册表组合为自主机理研究系统，可提出、排序并基于计算证据迭代修正机理假设。其在不对称催化立体控制过渡态、α-iodoboronate C-I 断裂自由基路径和镍催化迁移性交叉偶联选择性描述符三类案例中验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把机理推理、计算编排和证据驱动修正连成闭环，并公开了代码，为可审计的自主计算化学研究提供了具体系统原型。结论主要来自计算验证，实验复核、工具调用失败情形和跨反应体系泛化仍需独立评估。
items.abstract_zh: 阐明反应机制是现代化学的核心，但自动化这些研究仍具挑战性，因为计算工作流仍严重依赖专家干预。这里，我们引入 ARCHE，这是一个自主智能体系统，集成通用推理模型、领域专用计算化学模型和结构化工具注册表，将机理探究转化为可扩展、自验证的过程。ARCHE 解释科学问题，生成并优先排序机理假设，编排计算工作流，并在闭环中基于计算证据迭代细化结论。我们在三个要求逐步提高的场景中验证其能力：重建先前报道的不对称催化反应中控制立体选择性的过渡态并验证相应反应机制；通过迭代假设细化，为近期发现但尚未发表的 α-iodoboronate C-I 断裂反应提出并验证合理的自由基路径；以及识别支配镍催化迁移性交叉偶联反应选择性的、具有化学可解释性的描述符。通过将智能体推理与严格计算验证结合，ARCHE 推进了自主机理发现，并为更广泛的机器辅助化学研究奠定基础。ARCHE 的代码公开于 https://github.com/JetAstra/Arche-Harness。
items.author_line: Dong Li, Sixuan Mi, Zihao Ye, Huan Xiong, Tao XU, Tong Zhu, Aijia Zhang, Junqi Gao, Kaiyan Zhang, Shijie Wang, Bowen Zhou, Yuqiang Li, Biqing Qi

items.title: Accelerating Proton Affinity Prediction with Multi-Fidelity Machine Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate gas-phase proton affinities (PAs) are essential for designing proton carriers in anhydrous fuel cells, yet high-level quantum-chemical calculations are too expensive for large libraries. We develop a multi-fidelity Δ-learning framework that corrects PM7 semi-empirical estimates toward high-fidelity references using only PM7 electronic properties and cheminformatics descriptors, without DFT-derived features. On a 1,155-molecule NIST WebBook benchmark, an ExtraTrees model correction reduces the PM7 mean absolute error (MAE) from 8.21 to 2.87 ± 0.26 kcal/mol, a 47% reduction over a calibrated PM7 baseline of 5.44 ± 0.39 kcal/mol. A DFT-descriptor-based model trained to the same experimental targets yields 3.17 ± 0.24 kcal/mol, demonstrating that PM7-based features achieve comparable accuracy while avoiding DFT cost at inference. We extend Δ-learning to the harder task of site-specific prediction against a B3LYP/def2-TZVP reference, across 251 diverse molecules and 821 site-matched protonation sites, reducing the raw PM7 error from 10.26 to 7.44 ± 1.00 kcal/mol, versus 8.23 ± 1.02 kcal/mol for calibrated PM7. Functional-group and SHAP analyses identify correction patterns and high-variance cases where direct DFT remains preferable. We then apply the RandomForest model in a seven-stage workflow screening for candidate anhydrous proton carriers, combining similarity retrieval, PM7+Δ-ML prediction, Claude Opus 4.6-assisted preliminary donor–acceptor motif screening, and Pareto selection. From 821,435 filtered ZINC molecules, 30 candidates were DFT-validated, of which 29 fall within the target window (210–235 kcal/mol). Applied prospectively to these 30 molecules, the correction lowers the raw PM7 error from 13.51 to 3.99 kcal/mol. The DFT PA window, motif check, and functional-group exclusion retain 26 candidates, and the five ranked highest by DFT proton affinity span 226.6–234.3 kcal/mol, at or above the 225.3 kcal/mol PA of imidazole. These single-molecule calculations prioritize candidates for experiment but do not by themselves establish condensed-phase proton conductivity.
items.summary_zh: 研究提出多保真 Δ-learning，用 PM7 电子性质和化学信息学描述符校正质子亲和力预测。在 1,155 个分子的 NIST WebBook 基准上，MAE 由 8.21 降至 2.87 ± 0.26 kcal/mol；随后从 821,435 个 ZINC 分子中筛选候选物，并对其中 30 个进行 DFT 验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将廉价半经验计算、机器学习校正和前瞻性 DFT 筛选结合，可降低大规模质子载体初筛成本。作者明确指出单分子计算不能证明凝聚相质子电导；候选物仍需合成、稳定性和器件层面的实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 准确的气相质子亲和力（PAs）对于设计无水燃料电池中的质子载体至关重要，但高水平量子化学计算对于大型化合物库而言成本过高。我们开发了一种多保真 Δ-learning 框架，仅使用 PM7 电子性质和化学信息学描述符、而不使用 DFT 衍生特征，将 PM7 半经验估算校正至高保真参考值。在包含 1,155 个分子的 NIST WebBook 基准上，ExtraTrees 模型校正将 PM7 平均绝对误差（MAE）从 8.21 降至 2.87 ± 0.26 kcal/mol，相比校准 PM7 基线的 5.44 ± 0.39 kcal/mol 降低 47%。一个以相同实验靶标训练的基于 DFT 描述符的模型得到 3.17 ± 0.24 kcal/mol，表明基于 PM7 的特征可在推理时避免 DFT 成本的同时达到相近准确度。我们将 Δ-learning 扩展至更困难的位点特异性预测任务，以 251 个多样化分子和 821 个位点匹配质子化位点为对象，对照 B3LYP/def2-TZVP 参考值，将原始 PM7 误差从 10.26 降至 7.44 ± 1.00 kcal/mol，而校准 PM7 为 8.23 ± 1.02 kcal/mol。官能团和 SHAP 分析识别出校正模式及直接 DFT 仍更适宜的高方差情形。随后，我们将 RandomForest 模型用于一个七阶段工作流，以筛选候选无水质子载体，该工作流结合相似性检索、PM7+Δ-ML 预测、Claude Opus 4.6 辅助的初步供体–受体基序筛选及 Pareto 选择。在 821,435 个筛选后的 ZINC 分子中，有 30 个候选物经 DFT 验证，其中 29 个落在目标窗口（210–235 kcal/mol）内。前瞻性应用于这 30 个分子时，该校正将原始 PM7 误差从 13.51 降至 3.99 kcal/mol。DFT PA 窗口、基序检查和官能团排除保留了 26 个候选物，按 DFT 质子亲和力排名最高的五个候选物跨越 226.6–234.3 kcal/mol，达到或超过 imidazole 的 225.3 kcal/mol PA。这些单分子计算为实验确定候选物优先级，但本身并不能证明凝聚相质子电导。
items.author_line: Debjyoti Bhattacharya, Yifan Liu, Valentino R. Cooper, Wesley F. Reinhart

items.title: Assessing the performance of implicit ensembling of neural networks for proteochemometric modeling with RandomNets
items.abstract_or_text: RandomNets, a recently introduced neural-network architecture that emulates the feature and sample bagging of Random Forests through an implicit, vectorised ensemble, has shown promising performance for quantitative structure–activity relationship (QSAR) modelling, but so far only on random data splits. Here we evaluate RandomNets in a proteochemometric (PCM) setting on two benchmarks: an original dataset (BtH) and a newly prepared dataset derived from ChEMBL 35, comprising 571,197 interactions across 382,493 unique compounds and 2,023 unique targets. Models were built from Morgan fingerprints together with additional physicochemical and protein descriptors, and assessed under both random and temporal splits. All models were trained within QSPRpred, enabling reproducible and benchmark-agnostic comparison against the best-performing PCM models from BtH, a deep neural network (DNN_PCM) and a Random Forest (RF_PCM). RandomNets with two layers gave the best overall performance, notably improving on the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of the DNN baseline for the temporal split by 5.55% on the original dataset and 8.73% on the new dataset, while taking 2× less time to train on the original dataset and the same time on the new dataset. These results affirm the potential of RandomNets and extend it to PCM modelling.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在两个蛋白化学计量学（PCM）基准上评估 RandomNets：原始 BtH 数据集及由 ChEMBL 35 制备的新数据集，后者含 571,197 个相互作用、382,493 个化合物和 2,023 个靶点。两层 RandomNets 在时间划分下优于 DNN_PCM 的 MCC，并维持较低或相同训练时间。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 时间划分和大规模 ChEMBL 衍生基准使该比较比仅用随机划分更具说服力，也为 PCM 的隐式集成提供了候选架构。证据仍局限于两个基准及既定指纹、描述符和训练框架，跨靶标家族和真实前瞻性活性预测尚未证明。
items.abstract_zh: RandomNets 是近期提出的一种神经网络架构，它通过隐式、向量化集成模拟 Random Forests 的特征和样本 bagging，在定量构效关系（QSAR）建模中显示出有前景的性能，但此前仅在随机数据划分上得到验证。这里，我们在蛋白化学计量学（PCM）环境中、在两个基准上评估 RandomNets：原始数据集（BtH）和一个由 ChEMBL 35 新制备的数据集，后者包括 571,197 个相互作用、382,493 个独特化合物和 2,023 个独特靶点。模型以 Morgan 指纹以及附加物理化学和蛋白描述符构建，并在随机划分和时间划分下评估。所有模型均在 QSPRpred 内训练，从而能够与 BtH 中表现最佳的 PCM 模型、深度神经网络（DNN_PCM）和 Random Forest（RF_PCM）进行可复现且与基准无关的比较。两层 RandomNets 给出最佳总体性能，尤其是在时间划分下，相对原始数据集和新数据集上的 DNN 基线，Matthews correlation coefficient（MCC）分别提高 5.55% 和 8.73%；同时，在原始数据集上的训练时间缩短为 1/2，在新数据集上的训练时间相同。这些结果确认了 RandomNets 的潜力，并将其扩展至 PCM 建模。
items.author_line: Chiel Jespers, Olivier J. M. Béquignon, Mike Preuss, Gerard J. P. van Westen

items.title: Predicting Supramolecular Self-Assembly of Peptide Structures with AlphaFold3
items.abstract_or_text: Self-assembled peptide-based nanostructures have diverse applications in the pharmaceutical and materials fields, but accurately predicting their self-assembly behavior without time-intensive organic synthesis and characterization remains a significant challenge. Here, we assess the effectiveness of AlphaFold3 (AF3), a deep learning model for protein structure prediction, in modeling peptide-based nanostructures and the interactions driving supramolecular self-assembly. We designed amphiphilic peptides composed of alternating hydrophobic residues (valine, leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine) and hydrophilic residues (glutamic acid), varying both sequence length and residue order. Using AF3's multimer mode, we modeled assemblies with copy numbers ranging from 10 to 1000, generating diverse morphologies such as micelles and nanotubes. We qualitatively analyzed hydrophobic regions, secondary structures, and intermolecular interactions, while also calculating radii of gyration, packing scores, and aspect ratios using PyRosetta. Our results indicate that AF3 predicts morphologies consistent with hydrophobic driving forces and steric constraints. Increased hydrophobicity correlates with smaller radii of gyration, while higher copy numbers correspond to smaller aspect ratios (more compact structures). Longer hydrophobic segments lead to disordered structures, whereas longer hydrophilic segments promote organization. While AF3 captures systemic trends consistent with biophysical principles, comparisons to literature reveal discrepancies driven by charge effects and secondary structure bias, including an overemphasis on helical propensity (e.g., alanine-rich sequences) and sensitivity to terminal charge repulsion. Additionally, since AF3 is predisposed to predict a single assembled entity rather than higher-order assemblies such as multiple micelles or fibers, finding the optimal copy number for the best prediction requires system-specific iteration. These limitations highlight the need for complementary approaches with controlled chemical potential and environmental conditions, though qualitative agreement with experimental trends in morphology and compactness supports AF3's utility for initial structure generation. Our findings highlight AF3's potential as a user-friendly first pass screening tool for peptide design, enabling rapid generation and prioritization of candidate assemblies for subsequent evaluation using coarse-grained or all-atom molecular simulations toward the efficient development of functional self-assembled peptide nanomaterials.
items.summary_zh: 作者用 AlphaFold3（AF3）的 multimer 模式模拟由疏水残基和 glutamic acid 交替构成的两亲性肽，并在 10 至 1000 个拷贝数下分析胶束和纳米管等组装形态。AF3 捕捉到若干与生物物理原则一致的趋势，但与文献的比较也揭示其二级结构和电荷处理偏差。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究明确检验 AF3 能否作为肽自组装设计的初筛工具，并同时报告了失败模式，而非只呈现正向案例。结果为定性趋势和文献比较，且模型不能自然表示多胶束或纤维等高阶组装；后续仍需粗粒化或全原子模拟及实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 自组装肽基纳米结构在药物和材料领域具有多种应用，但在不进行耗时的有机合成和表征的情况下准确预测其自组装行为仍是一项重大挑战。这里，我们评估 AlphaFold3（AF3）这一蛋白结构预测深度学习模型在建模肽基纳米结构及驱动超分子自组装相互作用方面的有效性。我们设计了由交替的疏水残基（valine、leucine、isoleucine、phenylalanine）和亲水残基（glutamic acid）构成的两亲性肽，同时改变序列长度和残基顺序。使用 AF3 的 multimer 模式，我们对拷贝数从 10 到 1000 的组装体进行建模，生成包括胶束和纳米管在内的多种形态。我们定性分析了疏水区域、二级结构和分子间相互作用，同时使用 PyRosetta 计算回转半径、堆积评分和长宽比。我们的结果表明，AF3 预测的形态与疏水驱动力和位阻约束一致。更高的疏水性与更小的回转半径相关，而更高的拷贝数对应更小的长宽比（更紧凑的结构）。更长的疏水片段导致无序结构，而更长的亲水片段促进有序化。尽管 AF3 捕捉到与生物物理原则一致的系统性趋势，但与文献的比较揭示了由电荷效应和二级结构偏好造成的差异，包括对螺旋倾向的过度强调（例如 alanine-rich 序列）以及对末端电荷排斥的敏感性。此外，由于 AF3 倾向于预测单一组装实体，而非多个胶束或纤维等高阶组装体，寻找可获得最佳预测的最优拷贝数需要针对体系迭代。这些限制表明需要采用具有受控化学势和环境条件的互补方法，不过在形态和紧凑性上与实验趋势的定性一致支持 AF3 可用于初始结构生成。我们的发现凸显 AF3 作为用户友好型肽设计初筛工具的潜力，可快速生成并确定候选组装体的优先级，随后采用粗粒化或全原子分子模拟进行评估，以高效开发功能性自组装肽纳米材料。
items.author_line: Sklar, C., Huh, S., Chen, S., Gray, J. J.

items.title: Discovery of a molecular glue inhibitor that stabilises a non-productive Kalirin-Rac1 complex
items.abstract_or_text: Rho guanosine triphosphatases (GTPases) are molecular-switches implicated in neurodegenerative diseases, yet targeting them through competitive inhibition remains a challenge due to their high affinity for guanine nucleotides. Guanine nucleotide exchange factors (GEFs) catalyse GDP-to-GTP nucleotide exchange to activate GTPases, providing an alternative opportunity for GTPase modulation. Herein, we describe a complex-targeted strategy to inhibit nucleotide exchange with covalent molecular glues that engage the Kalirin-Rac1 GEF-GTPase complex at the nucleotide binding site are sequester the GEF Kalirin. Fragment hits were identified through XChem and in silico screening, and a fragment merging approach resulted in the generation of covalent inhibitors RS-009 and MC-278. Multiple analyses demonstrate our compounds inhibit nucleotide exchange both through competition with the nucleotides and by stabilising a ternary inhibitor-Rac1-Kalirin complex, thereby trapping Kalirin in a non-productive state and reducing GEF turnover. Biochemical selectivity screening and cellular activity-based protein profiling (ABPP) show that selectivity can be achieved across distinct GEF-GTPase complexes, which may result in improved spatiotemporal control over targeting the GTPase alone. This work provides evidence for targeting GTPase signalling via stabilization of the GEF-GTPase complex in a unique covalent molecular glue mechanism and provides the basis of a chemical probe or therapeutic.
items.summary_zh: 研究通过 XChem、in silico 筛选和片段合并得到共价分子胶 RS-009 与 MC-278，使 Kalirin-Rac1 GEF-GTPase 复合物稳定于非生产性状态。生化选择性筛选和细胞活性基蛋白质谱（ABPP）支持其可在不同 GEF-GTPase 复合物间取得选择性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 以稳定 GEF-GTPase 复合物而非仅竞争靶向 GTPase，为难成药 Rho GTPase 信号提出了新的共价分子胶策略，并有多层生化和细胞证据。其治疗价值目前仍是前临床推断，体内药效、安全性和更广泛选择性尚待验证。
items.abstract_zh: Rho guanosine triphosphatases（GTPases）是与神经退行性疾病相关的分子开关，但由于其对鸟嘌呤核苷酸具有高亲和力，通过竞争性抑制靶向它们仍具挑战。鸟嘌呤核苷酸交换因子（GEFs）催化 GDP 到 GTP 的核苷酸交换以激活 GTPases，为调节 GTPase 提供了另一种机会。本文描述了一种复合物靶向策略：使用在核苷酸结合位点结合 Kalirin-Rac1 GEF-GTPase 复合物并封存 GEF Kalirin 的共价分子胶来抑制核苷酸交换。通过 XChem 和 in silico 筛选识别片段命中物，片段合并方法产生了共价抑制剂 RS-009 和 MC-278。多项分析表明，我们的化合物既通过与核苷酸竞争抑制核苷酸交换，也通过稳定三元 inhibitor-Rac1-Kalirin 复合物发挥作用，从而将 Kalirin 困在非生产性状态并降低 GEF 周转。生化选择性筛选和细胞活性基蛋白质谱（ABPP）表明，可在不同的 GEF-GTPase 复合物之间实现选择性，这可能比单独靶向 GTPase 改善时空控制。该工作为通过稳定 GEF-GTPase 复合物、以独特的共价分子胶机制靶向 GTPase 信号提供了证据，并为化学探针或治疗方法奠定基础。
items.author_line: Gray, J. L., Callens, M. C., Henley, A., Zaidman, D., Jimenez Antunez, C., Thompson, A. P., Lei, Z., Skyner, R., Miller, M., Williams, E. P., Robinson, A., Seupal, R., Fry, M. T., Filep, M., von Delft, F., Willis, M. P., von Delft, A. R., London, N., Brennan, P. E.

items.title: Automatic Text-fishing, Unification, and Normalization Application in Python (aTUNApy): a tool to build molecular databases
items.abstract_or_text: The construction and maintenance of chemical databases from the scientific literature remain labor-intensive, largely because relevant information is dispersed across thousands of publications and compounds are reported under inconsistent nomenclature. Here we present aTUNApy (automatic Text-fishing, Unification, and Normalization Application in Python), an open-source tool that couples large language model (LLM)-based extraction of compound information from PubMed abstracts with nomenclature harmonization through PubChem and SMILES standardization with RDKit. aTUNApy retrieves articles for a user-defined query, extracts compound names together with user-specified attributes such as bioactivity, mechanism or source, and maps each mention to a unique PubChem identifier, collapsing synonyms onto a single canonical entry. Four LLM families are supported: GPT, Claude, LLaMA and Gemini. We benchmarked all four against a manually curated reference set of 507 articles, including 100 negative controls, covering 148 unique compounds. Claude achieved the highest performance (precision 0.98, recall 0.95, F1 0.97), while Gemini reached comparable precision (0.98) and the lowest hallucination rate (0.2%) at no API cost, reducing a five-day manual curation task to minutes or hours of automated processing. Finally, to demonstrate end-to-end utility, we applied aTUNApy to 8,273 articles from PubMed and Web of Science to build NutriEpiDB, a database of 653 dietary compounds with reported epigenetic effects across 917 food sources.
items.summary_zh: aTUNApy 以 LLM 从 PubMed 摘要中抽取化合物和指定属性，再用 PubChem 与 RDKit 完成命名统一及 SMILES 标准化。在 507 篇文章的人工参照集上，Claude 的 F1 为 0.97；作者还据此从 8,273 篇文章中构建了 NutriEpiDB。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工具将文献抽取、同义名归并和结构标准化串为可用的分子数据库构建流程，并报告了包含阴性对照的人工基准。其证据限于摘要文本和特定参照集；全文信息缺失、实体消歧及不同 LLM 的可复现性仍需关注。
items.abstract_zh: 从科学文献构建和维护化学数据库仍然劳动密集，主要是因为相关信息分散在数千篇出版物中，而且化合物以不一致的命名法报告。这里，我们提出 aTUNApy（automatic Text-fishing, Unification, and Normalization Application in Python），这是一种开源工具，将基于大语言模型（LLM）的 PubMed 摘要化合物信息提取，与通过 PubChem 进行的命名统一和通过 RDKit 进行的 SMILES 标准化相结合。aTUNApy 针对用户定义的查询检索文章，抽取化合物名称及用户指定的属性（如生物活性、机制或来源），并将每个提及映射到唯一的 PubChem 标识符，将同义词折叠为单一规范条目。支持四个 LLM 家族：GPT、Claude、LLaMA 和 Gemini。我们在一个由人工整理的 507 篇文章参照集上对四者进行了基准测试，该参照集包括 100 个阴性对照，涵盖 148 个独特化合物。Claude 达到最高性能（precision 0.98，recall 0.95，F1 0.97），而 Gemini 达到相当的 precision（0.98）和最低的幻觉率（0.2%），且无需 API 成本，将五天的人工整理任务缩短至数分钟或数小时的自动化处理。最后，为展示端到端实用性，我们将 aTUNApy 应用于来自 PubMed 和 Web of Science 的 8,273 篇文章，构建 NutriEpiDB：一个收录 653 种具有已报道表观遗传效应的膳食化合物、覆盖 917 种食物来源的数据库。
items.author_line: Aylin Del Moral Morales, José L. Medina-Franco

items.title: Data-driven strategies for enzyme engineering: From machine learning to protein language models
items.abstract_or_text: Enzymes are key biocatalysts that drive diverse biological processes and industrial applications, offering sustainable alternatives to conventional chemical catalysis. However, the enormous enzyme sequence space and the limited functional annotation have created an urgent demand for computational approaches to accelerate enzyme discovery and engineering. Recent advances in computational methods are accelerating enzyme engineering from empirical trial and error toward predictive design. This review summarizes representative computational tools and predictive models in the enzyme engineering workflow, including (1) enzyme data resources, (2) functional enzyme discovery, (3) enzyme property prediction (e.g., kinetics, optimal temperature and PH, solubility, promiscuity, and specificity), (4) de novo enzyme design, and (5) computationally guided enzyme optimization. We further compare current computational strategies, discuss their strengths and limitations in different engineering scenarios, and highlight emerging trends toward foundation models, generative artificial intelligence, multimodal learning, and closed-loop design–build–test–learn platforms.
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇酶工程计算方法综述，系统梳理酶数据资源、功能酶发现、动力学与最适温度等性质预测、de novo 酶设计和计算引导优化，并讨论基础模型、生成式 AI、多模态学习和闭环 DBTL 平台。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 综述为酶工程中的数据、预测与实验闭环提供了较完整的技术地图，有助于比较不同计算策略的适用场景。它不报告新的统一基准或实验结果，具体方法优劣仍应回到所引原始研究及其数据划分和实验设计判断。
items.abstract_zh: 酶是驱动多样生物过程和工业应用的关键生物催化剂，为传统化学催化提供了可持续的替代方案。然而，巨大的酶序列空间和有限的功能注释，使得迫切需要计算方法来加速酶发现和工程化。计算方法的最新进展正推动酶工程从经验性的试错走向预测性设计。本综述总结了酶工程工作流中具有代表性的计算工具和预测模型，包括：（1）酶数据资源，（2）功能酶发现，（3）酶性质预测（例如动力学、最适温度和 PH、溶解度、兼容性和特异性），（4）de novo 酶设计，以及（5）计算引导的酶优化。我们还比较了当前计算策略，讨论其在不同工程场景中的优势和局限，并强调了向基础模型、生成式人工智能、多模态学习和闭环 design–build–test–learn 平台发展的新兴趋势。
items.author_line: Shaozhen Ding, Peng Wu, Shubo Li, Yuxuan Yang, Han Zhu, Heng Yu, Yu Tian, Dachuan Zhang, Qian-Nan Hu

items.title: Molarium: Agent-Generated Adaptive Software for Molecular Design
items.abstract_or_text: Commercial drug discovery software has traditionally bundled three sources of value: the interface, the scientific models, and the specialized expertise required to run the models through the interface, thereby translating outputs into design decisions. Large language models, coding agents, and tool-using agents are beginning to unbundle this paradigm. Interfaces, analyses, workflow logic, and substantial portions of scientific software can increasingly be generated to meet the needs of a particular scientist, project, and question, while agents can automate sophisticated workflows that once required specialist users. This shift repositions where competitive advantage is created in computational drug discovery. More intuitive interfaces and faster execution alone do not fix model inaccuracies or broaden the applicability domain. As the underlying tooling becomes increasingly accessible and fluid, strategic differentiation will shift away from familiarity with a particular software package and toward superior preditive algorithms, more generalizable models, proprietary experimental data, accumulated discovery intelligence, and the human discernment needed to frame the right questions and evaluate the answers. Molarium, available at https://molarium.org , provides a case study of this transition in the context of molecular design software. Created during an intensive weekend effort of a tireless drug-discovery scientist and an AI coding agent, this open-source molecular workbench operates exclusively in a standard web browser. It integrates local molecular graphics, editing, conformer generation, energy minimization, molecular dynamics, machine-learned potentials, and protein-structure prediction workflows. Beneath its rapidly adaptable interface, Molarium maintains a versioned molecular state together with user actions, method specifications, provenance, and validation evidence. Decoupling an adaptable interface from an enduring scientific core points toward a broader architecture for generated adaptive software in drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: Molarium 以开源浏览器端分子工作台为案例，讨论由 LLM、编码智能体和工具调用智能体生成的自适应药物发现软件。系统整合分子编辑、构象生成、能量最小化、分子动力学、机器学习势和蛋白结构预测，并保存带版本的分子状态、方法和验证证据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其核心价值在于提出将快速变化的智能体生成界面与可追溯的科学内核解耦，为分子设计软件的可审计性提供架构方向。论文主要是案例与立场性论述，未给出系统性准确度、可重复性或与成熟软件的对照评估。
items.abstract_zh: 商业药物发现软件传统上捆绑了三种价值来源：界面、科学模型，以及通过界面运行模型并将输出转化为设计决策所需的专业知识。大语言模型、编码智能体和工具调用智能体正开始拆解这一范式。界面、分析、工作流逻辑和科学软件的相当大部分日益可以生成，以满足特定科学家、项目和问题的需求；而智能体可以自动化过去需要专业用户的复杂工作流。这一变化重新定位了计算药物发现中竞争优势产生的位置。更直观的界面和更快的执行本身并不能解决模型不准确问题，也不能扩大适用域。随着底层工具日益可及且流动，战略差异化将从对特定软件包的熟悉程度，转向更优的预测算法、更可泛化的模型、专有实验数据、积累的发现智能，以及提出正确问题和评估答案所需的人类判断力。Molarium 可通过 https://molarium.org 访问，它在分子设计软件的背景下提供了这一转变的案例研究。该开源分子工作台由一位不知疲倦的药物发现科学家和一个 AI 编码智能体在紧张的周末协作中创建，仅在标准网页浏览器中运行。它整合了本地分子图形、编辑、构象生成、能量最小化、分子动力学、机器学习势和蛋白结构预测工作流。在快速适应的界面之下，Molarium 保存带版本的分子状态，以及用户动作、方法规范、溯源和验证证据。将可适应界面与持久科学核心解耦，指向一种更广泛的、用于药物发现中生成式自适应软件的架构。

items.title: Self-Architecting Protein Transformers: An Empirical Study
items.abstract_or_text: Motivation. Protein language models (pLMs) such as ESM-2 and ProtBERT rely on pretraining corpora of tens to hundreds of millions of sequences and on encoder architectures whose depth, width and number of attention heads are chosen by the practitioner and never revisited during training. The entry cost of state-of-the-art pLMs is therefore out of reach for laboratories without industrial-scale infrastructure, and the fixed architecture provides no in-training diagnostic of whether the chosen capacity matches the structural complexity of the data. This work asks whether a self-architecting transformer, which grows its own width and depth from quantitative signals derived from the attention matrices, can extract competitive protein representations from a single reference proteome. Results. A three-level self-architecting framework, INCRT-geo, is applied to masked-language pretraining on the human Ensembl proteome (approximately twenty thousand sequences). On Pfam-50 family classification, the principal model attains a linear-probe accuracy that exceeds two pretrained baselines, ESM-2 small and ProtBERT, despite a corpus several orders of magnitude smaller. Three single-variable ablations isolate the contributions of one-residue tokenisation, depth growth and an asymmetry-loss regulariser; the regulariser is shown to be necessary for the depth-growth trigger to fire. Scaling pretraining to eight vertebrate proteomes does not improve Pfam accuracy under the available compute budget; the negative result is reported transparently. Architectural diagnostics indicate that the heads allocated by the framework are functionally diverse rather than redundant.
items.summary_zh: INCRT-geo 是可根据注意力矩阵定量信号自行扩展宽度和深度的 protein transformer。它仅在约两万条人类 Ensembl 蛋白序列上预训练，却在 Pfam-50 线性探针分类上超过 ESM-2 small 和 ProtBERT；消融实验解析了 tokenization、深度增长和正则项的作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究探索了以较低预训练数据与算力成本获得蛋白表征的架构自适应路线，并透明报告扩展至八种脊椎动物蛋白组未改善准确率的结果。评估主要集中于单一分类基准和有限计算预算，不能据此推断对结构、功能或设计任务的普遍优势。
items.abstract_zh: 动机。ESM-2 和 ProtBERT 等蛋白语言模型（pLMs）依赖数千万至数亿条序列的预训练语料，并依赖由实践者选择且在训练期间不再重新考察其深度、宽度和注意力头数的编码器架构。因此，state-of-the-art pLMs 的进入成本超出没有工业级基础设施的实验室的能力范围，而固定架构也无法在训练中诊断所选容量是否匹配数据的结构复杂性。本工作询问：一种根据从注意力矩阵导出的定量信号自行增长宽度和深度的自架构 transformer，是否能够从单个参考蛋白组中提取具有竞争力的蛋白表征。结果。一个三级自架构框架 INCRT-geo 被应用于人类 Ensembl 蛋白组（约两万条序列）的掩码语言预训练。在 Pfam-50 家族分类中，主模型的线性探针准确率超过两个预训练基线 ESM-2 small 和 ProtBERT，尽管其语料规模低了数个数量级。三个单变量消融实验分离了单残基 tokenization、深度增长和不对称损失正则项的贡献；结果显示，正则项是触发深度增长的必要条件。在可用计算预算下，将预训练扩展至八个脊椎动物蛋白组并未改善 Pfam 准确率；这一负结果被透明报告。架构诊断表明，该框架分配的注意力头在功能上是多样而非冗余的。
items.author_line: Cirrincione, G., Ficarra, E., Lovino, M.

items.title: Single-particle light scattering reveals structural heterogeneity of biomolecular condensates
items.abstract_or_text: Biomolecular condensates can be heterogeneous in composition, morphology, and material properties, but resolving this heterogeneity at the level of individual submicrometer condensates remains challenging. Here, we combine off-axis holographic imaging with quantitative light-scattering analysis and particle tracking to simultaneously measure the size, optical properties, interfacial structure, and hydrodynamic mobility of hundreds of individual condensates per minute. Applied to condensates formed by the N-terminal domain of Ddx4 (Ddx4N1), the method reveals two populations with distinct scattering signatures: compact particles with well-defined interfaces and structurally heterogeneous, non-compact assemblies. Their relative abundance varies systematically with ionic strength. Synthetic polymer controls show that pronounced structural heterogeneity is not a generic consequence of phase separation and suggest a role for interaction heterogeneity in promoting competing mesoscale structures. Mass-size scaling and Brownian aggregation simulations further show that aggregation with incomplete fusion of smaller protein-rich units provides a physical model for the non-compact population. Simultaneous optical and diffusion measurements further show that the two populations have distinct hydrodynamic properties. These results demonstrate that chemically homogeneous condensate-forming systems can populate distinct mesoscale structures that are obscured by ensemble-averaged measurements.
items.summary_zh: 研究把离轴全息成像、定量光散射和粒子追踪结合起来，以每分钟数百个颗粒的通量同时测量生物分子凝聚体的尺寸、光学性质、界面结构和流体动力学迁移率。对 Ddx4N1 凝聚体的测量显示紧凑颗粒与非紧凑异质组装体两种群体，且比例随离子强度变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 单颗粒多模态测量揭示了集合平均方法容易掩盖的介观结构异质性，并以聚合物对照和 Brownian aggregation 模拟支持机制解释。该工作不是 AI 模型研究，且结论目前集中于 Ddx4N1 和所用模型体系，其对其他凝聚体的普适性需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 生物分子凝聚体在组成、形态和材料性质上可能具有异质性，但在单个亚微米凝聚体层面解析这种异质性仍具挑战。这里，我们结合离轴全息成像、定量光散射分析和粒子追踪，同时测量每分钟数百个单个凝聚体的尺寸、光学性质、界面结构和流体动力学迁移率。将该方法应用于由 Ddx4 的 N 端结构域（Ddx4N1）形成的凝聚体，揭示出具有不同散射特征的两种群体：具有明确界面的紧凑颗粒，以及结构异质的非紧凑组装体。它们的相对丰度随离子强度系统性变化。合成聚合物对照表明，显著结构异质性并非相分离的一般后果，并提示相互作用异质性在促进竞争性介观结构中发挥作用。质量–尺寸标度和 Brownian aggregation 模拟进一步表明，较小富蛋白单元在未完全融合情况下发生聚集，为非紧凑群体提供了物理模型。同时进行的光学和扩散测量还表明，两种群体具有不同的流体动力学性质。这些结果表明，化学上均一的凝聚体形成体系可以形成不同的介观结构，而这些结构会被集合平均测量所掩盖。
items.author_line: Rodriguez, B. G., Makasewicz, K., Tesei, G., Eklund, F., Johansson, E., Arosio, P., Volpe, G., Midtvedt, D. S.

items.title: Digestion and Orthogonal Click Conjugation Enables Nanopore Reading of Proteins
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate characterization of bioactive peptides and proteins is needed to fully understand the origin of their activity. Nanopore reading enables polypeptide characterization at the single-molecule level. Here we describe a digestion-ligation method based on readily available reagents and benchtop equipment to convert peptides and proteins into DNA-peptide-DNA conjugates that can be analyzed by nanopores. Chymotrypsin digestion yields peptide fragments with C-terminal tyrosine residues suitable for oxidation-induced click chemistry. Subsequent selective installation of an azide on the N terminus enables installation of a template DNA strand needed for nanopore reading. The findings provide a facile approach to prepare DNA-peptide-DNA conjugates that has great potential for applicability to nanopore reading of many proteins.
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出消化—连接流程，将肽和蛋白转化为可经纳米孔分析的 DNA-peptide-DNA 偶联物。Chymotrypsin 消化得到 C 端 tyrosine 肽片段，再经氧化诱导 click chemistry 和 N 端 azide 的选择性安装连接模板 DNA。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法使用常见试剂和台式设备，为单分子纳米孔蛋白读出提供了较易实施的样品制备路径。摘要尚未给出跨蛋白的读出准确度、序列覆盖度或复杂样品表现，实际通用性仍需系统验证。
items.abstract_zh: 准确表征生物活性肽和蛋白对于充分理解其活性来源是必需的。纳米孔读出可在单分子层面对多肽进行表征。这里，我们描述了一种基于易得试剂和台式设备的消化–连接方法，将肽和蛋白转化为可由纳米孔分析的 DNA-peptide-DNA 偶联物。Chymotrypsin 消化产生 C 端带有 tyrosine 残基、适于氧化诱导 click chemistry 的肽片段。随后在 N 端选择性安装 azide，使得能够安装纳米孔读出所需的模板 DNA 链。这些发现提供了一种制备 DNA-peptide-DNA 偶联物的简便方法，具有应用于许多蛋白纳米孔读出的巨大潜力。
items.author_line: Jasper W. van de Sande, Xiuqi Chen, Cees Dekker, Bauke Albada
